conditions.text: Obtain access approval and confirm warehouse reachability for internal.airq.station_readings, resolve VR-03 status/gap handling, and update catalog status
Document counter-break adjustment for 2024-03-18, provide counter coordinates or station mapping, confirm time zone and DST handling, and test 2024-2025 access for internal.traffic.hourly_counts
Confirm Copernicus C3S licence terms and commercial-use position for api.open_meteo_archive, record confirmed Valdena coordinates in decisions.md, and run full-range missing-value checks
Resolve the CC BY 4.0 vs research-only conflict for link.uci_360, map -200 sentinels to null, and restrict usage to prototype method-building only
Obtain full dataset documentation and schema dictionary for link.lombardia_nicp_bhqi_eba0c8, verify 2004-2005 prototype coverage, and handle -9999 / NA sentinel entries before relying on it

Confirm whether a live warning use fits within the clinic data policy surveillance purpose, document district codes and small-cell suppression, and approve access for internal.clinic.resp_visits_daily
Confirm reuse licence terms for link.europa_sdg_11_52_099aa6 if used for national annual context on could need N6

agreements.reason: Keeping link.europa_sdg_11_52_099aa6 as feasible_with_conditions rather than rejecting it fits rule 2 because N6 is a could need, even though LIC-UNKNOWN is a blocker and coverage is partial (2005 and 2007-2023).
Marking the Chicago link not_feasible is right because catalog.data.gov is outside UC1's Italian geography and intentionally blocked by the allowlist guardrail.

traced_conclusion.could_change_if: If the prototype window were shifted to 2024-2025 instead of 2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04, temporal.end (2005-04-04) would make the source stale for that window rather than usable for prototype method-building.
